name: User Security
description: Password hashing, account lock, TOTP secret, trusted devices, and the passkeyEnabled MFA-posture flag (passkey credentials live in auth_passkey).
author: Kuray Karaaslan

extensions.description: The TOTP secret of the auth second factor, encrypted under the PER-USER data key (keyScope user, decision F27): it belongs to the person, not to a tenant.

metadata.label: MFA enabled
metadata.description: A user enabled a second factor (authenticator app, e-mail or SMS code) on their account.

metadata.label: MFA disabled
metadata.description: A second factor was removed from a user's account (by the user, or an administrator's reset).

extensions.description: Phase 55 01.6: the signal kinds this module emits (the audit actions it owns), each attribute with its personal-data class. Read by ai_firewall through its registry; imports only the contract from common.

metadata.label: user_security: the guessing lock, the security lock, second factors added and removed, trusted devices (phase 55 01.6)

extensions.description: Phase 55 01.6: the actions the firewall's responder may take through this module (execute and undo call its own functions). Observe on install; the responder (05) owns modes, budgets and evidence.

metadata.label: user_security: the security lock, revoke trusted devices (phase 55 01.6)
